---
title: "Chosen throw"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

The glider of [chapter 02](../02-flight-path/index.qmd), collocated as a rigid
body rather than a point mass, with the throw itself free.

- **Rigid body, collocated.** `theta` is a state, so "no loops" constrains a real
  variable rather than one the model cannot represent.
- **The throw is a design variable** — release speed and angle, with the
  geometry.
- **Marched verification, always**, through the parent's RK4 `simulate()`.
- **Left out:** lateral motion, gusts, launches far from the seed.
- **Held fixed:** everything chapter 01 fixed.

::: {.callout-tip}
## Specified

Asked of the user, 2026-09-09:

1. Optimise against a real flight path, no loops or stall.
2. Launch speed and angle free, speed capped `{python} f"{THROW_BOUNDS['speed'][1]:.0f}"` m/s.
3. Solve budget `{python} f"{solve_budget():.0f}"` s, in `_budget.py`.
4. Entry ceiling `{python} f"{ENTRY_CEILING:.0f}"` s, raised likewise.
5. Probe budget `{python} f"{PROBE_BUDGET_CHAPTER:.0f}"` s, granted for this chapter.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## Assumed

No owner yet — each is a candidate for its own entry:

1. Released along the flight path, at zero incidence.
2. Pitch attitude bounded `{python} f"{THETA_LIMIT:.0f}"`° either side of level.
3. Seeded from one converged RK4 launch.
4. Limited-memory Hessian; the exact one carries NaNs.
:::
